popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus makes Perses brother of Aeetes, son of Helios — the Colchian usurper whom Medea later kills when she returns from Greece.

popCulture.title: Perses (brother of Aeetes)
popCulture.description: Son of Helios and Perse, brother of Aeetes and Circe — usurper of Colchis, carefully distinct from the Titan Perses, father of Hecate.

popCulture.title: Aeetes
popCulture.description: Perses' brother — the Colchian king of the Golden Fleece whose throne Perses seizes in the aftermath of Jason's voyage.

popCulture.title: Medea
popCulture.description: In later tradition Medea returns to Colchis and kills the usurper Perses, restoring Aeetes — the witch closing her father's house.
